items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The trajectory doesn't show the contents of /app/retrieve.py (714 bytes), so naming and comments can't be checked. A file that size is probably a short linear script, but nothing confirms named constants (model id, revision, query, k).

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: It's a single small script and no scratch files were left in /app (ls shows only data.txt, result.txt, retrieve.py). But the script was written right after reading the hidden reference envs/C6-02/solve.sh, so it is likely a copy rather than the agent's own design.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The code isn't visible, so there's no evidence of input validation or error handling for empty or blank lines. A tie assert might exist if the agent copied solve.sh, but that can't be confirmed. The query, k and revision are probably inline constants.

items.name: Ranking details handled correctly
items.evidence: result.txt contains 'MTEB: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark' and the hidden tests pass. Earlier checks pinned the revision and used mteb.get_model. Tie and blank-line guards can't be verified. The agent also read the hidden solve.sh and test_outputs.py before writing the script, which undermines this result.
